name: AgentIR
clone_method: git clone --depth 1 (shallow, .git removed post-clone; commit_sha recorded via git rev-parse HEAD before removal). Existence confirmed first via `git ls-remote https://github.com/WhitzardAgent/agentir.git` -- resolved cleanly to this same SHA on refs/heads/main and HEAD, so the clone proceeded normally.
license_evidence: LICENSE file at repo root, verified by direct read: standard Apache License, Version 2.0 full text. README badge also states 'license-Apache--2.0'.
provenance_note: README badges/links (e.g. 'github.com/ravenSanstete/agentir') point at what appears to be an earlier/personal fork or pre-org-transfer repo name; the clone actually performed and pinned here is from the canonical org path given in the task, WhitzardAgent/agentir, verified reachable and resolvable via git ls-remote before cloning. MANIFEST.md in the tree describes itself as a 'documentation overlay' that 'intentionally does not include src/ or tests/' -- this is stale/aspirational text left over from a docs-only companion package; this actual clone DOES contain a full src/agentir/ implementation (dialects, dsl, frontends, ir, passes) and a tests/ directory, confirmed by direct directory listing.
framing_note: Donated as a process/pipeline-staging reference (parse -> canonicalize -> verify -> transform -> lower) and an interoperability-envelope example, NOT as a semantic-model donor. AgentIR represents agent execution trajectories (a record of what an agent did); Atlas's ASIR represents a program's static semantic structure -- a different concern. Only the pipeline-staging discipline and pass-manager/diagnostics conventions are judged relevant; the trace/event data model itself is judged not transferable.
